en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a small European town bordered by rolling hills and farmland. In the foreground are narrow streets lined with closely packed, steep‑roofed houses and small town buildings. A curving road and railway or path separate the town from a wooded slope with a large, manor‑like building or small castle partly hidden by trees. Further in the distance are scattered houses, church‑like structures, chimneys, and open fields stretching to low hills on the horizon.
